extDescription.message: Replace the tab title of the sites you choose with any text you want, and keep it pinned when the page tries to change it back.

optionsSubtitle.message: Replace the tab text of the sites you choose with your own words. Saved rules apply to open tabs immediately, and the site's own title changes get reverted.

rulesHint.message: Rules are matched from top to bottom and the first match wins. Disabled rules are skipped.

testIdle.message: Enter a URL to see which rule would rewrite it.

helpHostDesc.message: This domain and all of its subdomains, for example {c1}.

helpPathDesc.message: Only pages whose path starts with {c1}; {c2} matches any path.

helpRegexDesc.message: Wrap the rule in {c1} to match the full URL with a regular expression.

helpFootnote.message: This extension only changes the tab title. Nothing on the page itself is touched.

statusSavedLocal.message: Saved to local storage. Open tabs update immediately.

errNeedTitle.message: Enter the tab title to show

errDuplicate.message: Duplicate of a rule above; only the first one applies

testNeedUrl.message: Enter a URL first, for example {c1}

testBadUrl.message: That URL can't be parsed. Check the format.

testMiss.message: No rule matches this URL (disabled rules don't count).

testHit.message: Matched rule {b1}; the tab title will read {b2} (tested URL: {c1})

errRuleEmpty.message: The site rule can't be empty

errMissingHost.message: The rule is missing a domain

errHostWildcard.message: Wildcards aren't allowed in the domain part; use a subdomain or the /regex/ form

errStorageUnavailable.message: Extension storage is unavailable; rules can't be saved

popupFieldLabel.message: Change this site's tab title to

popupNotWeb.message: This tab isn't a regular web page

popupOnlyHttp.message: Only http and https pages can be rewritten.

popupNoRule.message: No rule for this site yet

popupBadSite.message: This address is invalid, so no rule can be created

popupApplied.message: Applied. This tab updates right away.

popupNewRuleHint.message: New rule {c1}. Open "All rules" to narrow the scope.
